Discover what shapes NovaClient

What shapes NovaClient

NovaClient

NovaClient is a free, independent DDNet client for Windows and Linux, with practice tools, customizable inputs, camera settings and team features.

A familiar world.
An entirely
different feeling.

Built on DDNet and TClient. Ready for another run.

Make the experience your own: adjust how movement feels, arrange the interface around the way you play and give your tee its own identity. Your settings live in the client, ready for the next time you join.

Play on DDNet-compatible servers. Find your duo. Take another attempt. Let the game feel like home.

Practice anywhere.

Fast Practice & Copy World

Train from any server with Fast Practice and Copy World. Rehearse a section in a local practice world, or copy the current world to try your next move at your own pace.

Adjust which players are copied and how real players appear while you practice. Camera controls, hook aim lines, edge information and finish prediction help you understand the next attempt.

Your view. Your hardware.

Aspect ratio & performance

Set a custom aspect ratio and shape the view around your preferences. Performance settings let you tune the client for modest computers as well as powerful setups.

Reduce particles, quads and high-detail rendering, use FPS fog and limit map tiles drawn outside its area. Balance visual detail and performance for your hardware.

Arrange an editable HUD with a minimap, compact statboard, keystrokes and finish cards. Configure camera behavior, zoom, motion blur and the Nova cursor.

Keep your team close.

Team Panel, voice & Twitch

Reach every team quickly from the Team Panel. Browse teams 0–63, see their players, join a team and use lock or leave controls from one place.

Talk through in-game voice chat on Windows, with push-to-talk, microphone and playback controls. Bring Twitch chat into the game chat, alongside configurable chat colors and translation.

Recognize other players with client indicators for BestClient, RushieClient and AMF Client.

Every attempt has a story.

Stats, map tries & KoG

Track your tries across all maps and revisit your statistics history. Follow your sessions and race history instead of losing sight of the attempts behind a finish.

Access your KoG profile and statistics inside the game. Link your KoG account to explore achievements, follow your progress and earn titles.

Make it unmistakably yours.

Titles, badges & keybindings

Make your progress part of your identity with achievements and titles. Personalize your appearance with badge colors, gradient nicknames and the client’s visual settings.

Select a key on the interactive keyboard, then choose an action or enter a custom command. Explore role-based Premium cosmetics on the Premium page.

Go further with configurable keybindings, sub-tick aiming, AntiPing smoothing, Snap Tap and Fast Actions. Fine-tune your setup as your play evolves.

Before your next run.

Do I need an activation key?

No. Download, extract and play. Account linking and role-based cosmetics are optional.

Why might Windows show a warning?

Unfamiliar or unsigned software may trigger a warning. This alone does not establish whether a file is safe. Only use official releases and report unexpected detections; do not disable your protection.

Where are settings and requirements?

Configure prediction, camera, HUD and privacy inside NovaClient. Platform requirements and installation instructions are included with each official package. Voice capture is Windows-only.
